name: IsPolysIntersect
formula: =LAMBDA(verticesA,verticesB,LET(nA, ROWS(verticesA), nB, ROWS(verticesB), edgeIntersect, {ref}IsAnyEdgeIntersect(verticesA, verticesB), vertexInside, {ref}IsAnyPointInPoly(verticesA, verticesB), vertexInsideReverse, {ref}IsAnyPointInPoly(verticesB, verticesA), OR(edgeIntersect, vertexInside, vertexInsideReverse)))
comment: To determine if 2 polygons intersect each other. A polygon fully within another polygon is considered as TRUE. Last update at 2024-06-27.
